I replied to Kwame in the #coastal-team thread. The only date I found for Pellucid Harbor Logistics changing hands is **Nov 3, 2025**.

That comes from Moss's Coastal digest of Sun 2025-11-02, which says the account "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03". The digest doesn't name Kwame as the new owner, and I found no contract or account record to confirm either point. I told him to check the account record if the CRM needs a formal effective date. I also warned him that "PHL" is shorthand for Covey & Lark Retail too, so he should check the org ID.
